RIYA NARAYAN

+91 99887 77665 | riya.narayan.genai@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/riyanarayan-genai | github.com/riyanarayan | Hyderabad, Telangana
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Generative AI Developer specializing in LLM applications, AI Agents, NLP and Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems. Strong experience building AI copilots, intelligent search platforms and enterprise automation solutions using state-of-the-art language models.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology — Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (2021–2025)
Vellore Institute of Technology | CGPA: 9.3/10
Relevant Coursework: Artificial Intelligence, NLP, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, Cloud Computing
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, JavaScript
AI/ML Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex
Data & Tools: Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Pandas, NumPy, Streamlit
Platforms: AWS, Azure, Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions
EXPERIENCE
Generative AI Intern — FutureMind AI (Feb 2025 – Present)
• Developed enterprise copilots using GPT-4, Claude and Llama.
• Built vector-search systems handling 500,000+ embeddings.
• Improved customer support response time by 62%.

AI Research Intern — SmartData Labs (Jun 2024 – Dec 2024)
• Built transformer-based document intelligence systems.
• Developed summarization models processing 50,000+ documents.
PROJECTS
Legal Document Intelligence Platform | Llama 3, RAG, ChromaDB
• Reduced contract review time by 80%.

Enterprise Knowledge Assistant | GPT-4, LangChain
• Achieved 94% user-rated relevance across testing.

AI Voice Assistant | Whisper, Python, FastAPI
• Delivered 95% speech recognition accuracy.
CERTIFICATIONS
Azure AI Engineer Associate
Generative AI Professional Certification
Machine Learning Specialization — Coursera
ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Smart India Hackathon Grand Finalist.
Top 5% in National AI Coding Competition.
Academic Excellence Award (Highest GPA in Department).
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Core Member, Generative AI Community.
Mentored 30+ students in Python and Machine Learning.
Speaker at university AI workshops and hackathons.
